entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for holding. You're speaking with Isaac at VeloFit. How can I assist you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about returning a VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number?
Sure, the name is Maria Flores, and the order number is VF-92144-B.

Thank you, Maria. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered on December 15th of last year. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. It works fine. To be honest, it was something of an impulse buy. I've simply changed my mind about it.
I see. And you're just not finding it useful?
Exactly. I thought I would use it every day, but I just don't use it enough to justify keeping it. I know I'm outside the usual 30-day window most companies have, so I'm not expecting a full refund.
I understand completely. Sometimes a product just doesn't fit into your routine the way you expect.

Right. So, since a full return is probably not an option, could we maybe work something out? Like a partial store credit? Or if I have to try and resale it myself, maybe a discount code for a future purchase?
I appreciate you explaining the situation, Maria. Let me just review our official return policy for you. Please hold for one moment.
Okay, thank you.
Alright, thank you for waiting. I've just checked our internal knowledge base, and you're actually in luck. Our policy states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Wait, really? Ninety days? I was sure it would be less.
Yes, you're still well within the window. As long as the VeloBand is in its original condition with the packaging and charging cable, we can process a full refund for you. No negotiation needed.
Wow, that's fantastic! That's much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you!

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just package it up, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Perfect. Thank you so much for your help, Isaac.
It was my pleasure, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Have a great day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
